title: Business Validation Rules Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating business rule definitions for ISO 20022 payment messages

message_type.description: The ISO 20022 message type these rules apply to (e.g., pacs.008.001.10, pacs.009.001.10, camt.052.001.10, camt.053.001.10)

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule set

id.description: Unique rule identifier following pattern MSGTYPE-XXNN (e.g., PACS008-AM01, CAMT053-BL01)

description.description: Human-readable description of what the rule checks

severity.description: Severity level: error (must be fixed), warning (should be reviewed), info (informational only)

condition.description: Expression defining when the rule applies (e.g., 'always', 'if field X exists', 'if amount > 10000')

assertion.description: Expression defining what must be true for the rule to pass (e.g., 'field Y is not empty', 'amount > 0')

field_paths.description: Array of XPath-like field paths involved in this rule

suggestion.description: Optional suggestion on how to fix the issue if the rule fails

category.description: Optional category for grouping related rules (e.g., 'amount', 'party', 'date', 'regulatory')

references.description: Optional references to external standards or documentation

examples.description: Optional examples of valid and invalid scenarios
